overview_description.description: Aegis AI develops an AI-native email security platform that helps organizations detect and respond to email-based cyber threats. The platform uses coordinated AI agents to analyze email content, sender behavior, and communication patterns to identify phishing attempts, business email compromise, malware, ransomware, spam, and other evolving threats. It integrates with email services such as Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 through APIs, allowing deployment without requiring changes to existing mail routing. The platform provides automated threat detection, quarantine and remediation capabilities, along with reporting and visibility into targeted attacks and security trends. Aegis AI also supports security teams by reducing manual review efforts and adapting to emerging email threats through AI-driven analysis rather than relying solely on static rules or signatures.

about_short_description.short_description: Aegis AI is an email security platform that leverages AI agents to analyze emails like human analysts.

product.name: Aegis AI Email Security Platform
product.description: An API-based email security platform that uses AI agents to analyze messages, detect threats, and automate investigation, quarantine, and remediation across cloud email environments.

product.name: AI Email Phishing Prevention
product.description: An AI-driven phishing prevention service that detects personalized, zero-day, social-engineering, and credential-theft emails by analyzing message intent and context.

product.name: Business Email Compromise Prevention
product.description: A service for detecting and stopping business email compromise, including executive impersonation, invoice fraud, vendor compromise, and fraudulent payment requests.

product.name: Inbound Email Security
product.description: Cloud-based inbound email protection for detecting and managing phishing, malware, ransomware, spam, impersonation, and other malicious messages before or after delivery.

product.name: Shadow IT Discovery
product.description: An email-based discovery service that identifies applications and SaaS services used by employees, including unauthorized or unapproved tools and potential data-sharing risks.

product.name: AI Red Teaming
product.description: An authorized security testing service that uses AI agents to run scoped spear-phishing simulations against employees and assess organizational exposure to social-engineering attacks.
